spans.s:
चुण् चुण्, cl. 6. P. चुणति, &c., to cut off,
pierce, divide; [cf. Hib. guinim, ‘I
wound, prick, sting;’ guinneach, ‘sharp-pointed;’
gun-ta, ‘wounded.’]

चूण् चूण्, cl. 10. P. चूणयति, -यितुम्, to
contract; to close or shrink.

चुण्ट् चुण्ट् [cf. rt. चुट् and चुट्ट्], cl. 1. 10.
P. चुण्टति, चुण्टयति, &c., to cut off,
pierce, divide; cl. 1. P. चुण्टति, to become small.

चुण्टा and ई, f. a small well or reservoir near a
well; [cf. चौण्ट्य, चूडक, चूतक.]

चुण्ठ् चुण्ठ्, cl. 10. P. चुण्ठयति, &c.,
to hurt, kill.

चुण्ड् चुण्ड् [cf. rt. चुट् and चुट्ट्], cl. 1. P.
चुण्डति, &c., to become small; cl. 10. P.
चुण्डयति, to cut off.
चुण्ढी, f. a small well. See चुण्टा above.
